snippet.title: Corebreaker - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the reveal trailer for Corebreaker, a 2D fast-paced action-platformer developed by aQuadiun. Players will unlock abilities, upgrades, and powerful weapons as they fight through unique biomes across the game. Explore a world extinct of humanity leaving robots to inhabit the planet and utilize the game's fluid movement to climb the Global Leaderboards. Corebreaker is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
